findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: BASH_ENV propagates to descendant Bash processes, while the DEBUG trap has no wrapper-process guard. findings.smallest_fix: Restrict injection to the wrapper PID and assert a fresh marker written after its descriptor reopen; include enough surrounding trap and stub context to verify the anchor.
